title: From Copilot Rollout to AI Workplace: Adoption, Agents & Real Business Value with Christoffer Besler Hansen [MVP]
description:
Rolling out Microsoft 365 Copilot is easy; getting thousands of employees to use it and proving value is not. Microsoft MVP Christoffer Besler Hansen of Atea shares practical lessons for IT and business leaders on adoption, agents, Copilot Studio, governance and cost control on the way to a real AI workplace.
In this episode
00:00 – Introduction and guest01:40 – Christoffer's journey into Microsoft technology03:03 – What an AI workplace is and why training matters06:07 – Expectations, licenses and measuring value15:16 – Time savings, Researcher and preparing data22:24 – From Copilot to agents and Copilot Studio27:29 – Agents that take actions, guardrails and the Agent 365 SDK41:45 – Agent lifecycle, shadow AI, FinOps and the future of work
Key takeaways
Buying Copilot licenses is not enough; continuous, role-based training is what keeps people using AI after the first few weeks.Organizations should measure AI value against real business outcomes, prepare and label their data, and move step by step from informational agents to agents that take actions with guardrails.Agent sprawl, shadow AI and rising token costs call for lifecycle policies, good sanctioned tools and FinOps thinking about which model and tool to use for each task.
Worth quoting
“Of course but the technology is moving very quickly. It's new modules and new things every week but getting people to actually change your habits takes time.” – Christoffer Besler Hansen (04:42)
